content.text: Two hours of screaming in the middle of the night would flatten anyone. It's common at this age, and it's often a sleep-terror-type waking, where he screams but isn't really awake. The thing families try is staying calm nearby, keeping the lights low, and not trying to fully wake or pick him up out of it. Waking him can drag it out. If he seems hurt, feverish, or in pain, call 811 any time, and 911 if it's an emergency.
